# ODBMS.org

> > A comprehensive resource portal covering operational database management systems, object-oriented databases, AI, big data, NoSQL, and data science technologies.

ODBMS.org features expert interviews with industry leaders like Vint Cerf and Philippe Kahn, technical articles on database systems, and in-depth coverage of emerging technologies in database management, artificial intelligence, and cloud platforms. The site serves as a knowledge hub for database professionals, researchers, and practitioners exploring both traditional and modern data management approaches.

## Key Topics

- Object-Oriented Databases
- Database Management Systems
- Artificial Intelligence
- Big Data
- NoSQL
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Cloud Platforms
- Database Programming
- Orthogonal Persistence
- Concurrency Control
- Query Optimization
- Referential Integrity
- BigQuery DataFrames
- MySQL HeatWave

## Home

- [ODBMS.org – Operational Database Management Systems](https://www.odbms.org): Homepage for ODBMS.org covering databases, AI, big data, and NoSQL resources

## Database Architecture & Design

- [Hitting the Relational Wall](https://www.odbms.org/2005/01/029-01-hitting-the-relational-wall): Andrew Wade discusses object vs relational database selection challenges
- [Referential Integrity Is Important For Databases](https://www.odbms.org/2005/11/referential-integrity-is-important-for-databases): Michael Blaha on referential integrity constraints in OODBMS systems
- [Achieving High Concurrency in OO Databases](https://www.odbms.org/2006/03/achieving-high-concurrency-in-oo-databases): Bob Bretl on concurrency control and transaction management in OO databases

## Object-Oriented Database Programming

- [Contracted Persistent Object Programming](https://www.odbms.org/2005/11/contracted-persistent-object-programming): Stephanie Balzer on orthogonal persistence in object-oriented programming
- [Next Generation of Virtual Platforms](https://www.odbms.org/2005/10/next-generation-of-virtual-platforms): Suad Alagic on virtual platforms with parametric types and persistence

## Performance & Optimization

- [Optimizing And Parallelizing Loops In Object-Oriented Database Programming Languages](https://www.odbms.org/1992/01/optimizing-and-parallelizing-loops-in-object-oriented-database-programming-languages): Article by Daniel F. Lieuwen on loop optimization in OO database languages
- [Parallel Pointer-based Join Techniques for Object-Oriented Databases](https://www.odbms.org/1993/01/parallel-pointer-based-join-techniques-for-object-oriented-databases): Research on parallel join algorithms for OO databases by Lieuwen & DeWitt
